name: source_independence
minimum_rule: No discovery accession and no prior validation accession in confirmatory source set; sample/donor field available
interpretation_if_failed: Integrated atlas can be used for exploratory source-level mapping, not as fully independent donor-level replication

name: label_harmonization
minimum_rule: Target label has an explicit field-level mapping and no unresolved F8-versus-F7 ambiguity for the tested contrast
interpretation_if_failed: Use exact atlas label for analysis and restrict the claim to atlas-defined F7; do not call it a direct F8 replication

name: primary_sample_level_replication
minimum_rule: Pre-specified target-versus-non-target contrast; at least 9 of 12 eligible samples positive for each core module; directionally positive median effect
interpretation_if_failed: Keep result as CAUTION and do not upgrade the mechanistic claim

name: candidate_panel_support
minimum_rule: At least 10 of 12 positive samples and BH-adjusted one-sided q<0.05 for a candidate; report all 15 frozen candidates
interpretation_if_failed: Do not replace failed genes or add post hoc candidates

name: competition_robustness
minimum_rule: Core module direction remains positive after explicit ECM, TGF/fibrosis, inflammation, hypoxia, and cell-cycle competitor audits; residual support in at least 8 of 12 samples
interpretation_if_failed: Reclassify the signal as shared fibrosis/state signal if the core effect is attenuated or reverses

name: leave_one_sample_out
minimum_rule: No single-sample deletion reverses the sign of a core module or the primary composite
interpretation_if_failed: Treat the finding as sample-sensitive and retain CAUTION

name: mechanosensor_specificity
minimum_rule: PIEZO2 is supportive only if its own direction and sample-level support pass; it is not required for the broader mechanical-transduction claim
interpretation_if_failed: State that channel-specific evidence is weak/negative; focus the manuscript on integrin-actomyosin and downstream mechanotransduction

name: source_stacking
minimum_rule: Do not count overlapping source rows as independent replications; source-level atlas rows are descriptive only
interpretation_if_failed: Deduplicate GSE173252 and PRJNA607098 before any cross-source synthesis
